title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the DataFrame provided. Which column should you filter to find stores with at least $$150$$ bananas?

title: Filtering the DataFrame
text: To filter the DataFrame for stores with at least $$150$$ bananas, you need to use a condition on the 'inventory' column. What condition would you use?

title: Applying the Filter
text: Pass the condition back into the frame: `fruit[fruit['inventory'] $$ \geq $$ 150]`. The inner part gives True/False for every row, and the outer brackets keep the rows that are True.

title: Sorting the DataFrame
text: After filtering, how do you sort the DataFrame to have the highest-priced bananas at the top?

title: Sorting Order
text: When sorting by price, should the 'ascending' parameter be set to True or False to have the highest prices first?

title: Applying the Sort
text: Chain the sort onto the filtered frame: `fruit[fruit['inventory'] $$ \geq $$ 150].sort\_values('price', $$ascending=False)`$$. Setting $$`ascending=False`$$ sorts from the highest price down.
